A '''zwevel''' was a type of [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]] found in deeper sections of the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]],<ref name="GCG" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> "Zwevel" was used by the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]],<ref name="GCG" /> a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to Mon Calamari,<ref name="UAA" /> as a first name for some members of the [[Gender/Legends|female]] sex.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The zwevel gemstones were first mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] sourcebook for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]]. They were only described in a table of Quarren female names.<ref name="GCG" />
